summary: Camera/view-mode dispatcher driven by player input. Resolves a mode override (forcing mode 2 when a replay or camera-lock condition holds), then dispatches on the mode: cycling cockpit/TV/external views (0-2) via a signed step with wrap and vehicle-index clamping; absolute selection for modes 1 and 2; TV mode 3; sub-mode option cycling for mode 4; and special modes 7-8 that copy UI-state globals into sub-objects and invoke a vtable method. Every active path converges on a shared tail that plays an audio effect and calls the subsystem call before returning the float-keyed field selector.

operations.description: Mode override: when byte_7CFE88, the mode request is not 3, the camera-lock byte at dword_7C54E0+13388 is clear, or dword_8AB6E4 equals 2, the request is used as-is; otherwise the mode is forced to 2 with a zero sub-step.
Dispatch to one of the cases 0-8 through the switch jump table jpt_409487 keyed on the resolved mode value.
Modes 0-2 (guard on mode +0x34 <= 2): the input is interpreted as either an absolute button press or a cycle step depending on a4.
Absolute selection: mode 1 stores 1 into +0x34 (mode) and +0x50 (position); mode 2 stores 2 into both and derives the audio index from dword_7CFCC8; mode 0 stores 0 into +0x50 with audio index 3.
When dword_7C54E0 is non-zero, play the audio sound effect with the selected index.
When the mode at +0x34 is non-zero, invoke the conditional subsystem call with the dword_7CF680 parameter.
Return FloatKeyedFieldSelector driven by the mode float at +0x34.
Cycle path with no button press: derive a -1/0/+1 step from the sign of the sub-step, then wrap the position +0x50 by that step within 0..2 while the mode at +0x34 is 0-2.
Vehicle-index comparison: when the tracked vehicle index (dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54DC]) matches dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54E4], skip the position clamp.
Position clamp after a cycle: at +0x50 == 1, an upward step with dword_7CFCC8 set forces +0x50 to 2; at +0x50 == 2 with dword_7CFCC8 clear, reset +0x50 to 0.
Commit the cycled position back into the mode at +0x34 (1 or 2, deriving the audio index from dword_7CFCC8), or into mode 0 with audio index 3.
Mode 3 (TV): set +0x34 to 3 and fall to the shared audio tail.
Mode 4 (sub-mode): only re-index when the mode at +0x34 equals 4 and the sub-step is non-zero (guard:1).
Sub-mode cycling: an upward step increments the sub-index +0x3C, wrapping to 0 at the option count +0x38; a downward step decrements it, wrapping to +0x38 - 1.
Enter sub-mode (set +0x34 to 4) only when the option count at +0x38 is positive (guard:2).
Modes 5-8: store the requested mode directly into +0x34.
Mode 7: copy UI-state globals dword_5EA550, dword_5EA554 and dword_5EA558 into the sub-object at +0x2C (base +188), and clear dword_5BE900.
Mode 8: copy UI-state globals dword_5EA500, dword_5EA504 and dword_5EA508 into the sub-object at +0x30 (base +188), and clear dword_5BE900.
Mode 8: invoke the __thiscall vtable method at vtable+0x1C on the sub-object at +0x30.
Shared tail: when dword_7C54E0 is non-zero play audio effect index 0; then call the conditional subsystem call with parameter 0 and return the float-keyed field selector for the mode at +0x34.
